---
title: "Quarto Website"
---

Hello, welcome to my portfolio website

<form id="addForm">
  <input type="number" id="numInput" required />
  <button type="submit">Add 1</button>
</form>

<div id="result"></div>

<script>
const API_URL = "https://cvmvfc2dfk.execute-api.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/prod";

document.getElementById("addForm").addEventListener("submit", async (e) => {
  e.preventDefault();
  const value = Number(document.getElementById("numInput").value);

  try {
    const res = await fetch(API_URL, {
      method: "POST",
      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
      body: JSON.stringify({ number: value })
    });

    const json = await res.json();
    document.getElementById("result").innerText =
      "Lambda returned: " + json.result;

  } catch (err) {
    console.error("Error calling Lambda:", err);
    document.getElementById("result").innerText =
      "Error calling Lambda. Check console.";
  }
});
</script>
